text: No, the analysis found no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger on this property after 2020. The assessment covered the entire asset from 2021 to 2025 using high-resolution satellite data (30m pixels). While minor changes below the detection threshold (e.g., narrow strips or areas under 0.5 ha) might have occurred, no significant loss was observed. The property retained over 91% of its forest cover as of 2020. The result is supported by two independent datasets (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020) and meets the method’s corroboration criteria.
